title: fagara articulata
intro: Fagara articulata, commonly known as Zanthoxylum articulatum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Fagara articulata include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable remedy for treating fever, diarrhea, and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
